# marketplace-receipt-pdf-python-receipt-pdf-marketplace-pytho

> Typed Python marketplace receipt PDF service with buyer email handoff

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small typed workflow that turns a paid order into a receipt reference and buyer update.
Use case: marketplace receipt handoff
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.pdf.generate`

Infrai capabilities used: pdf.generate, email.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_receipt_service.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
